name: Finish The Race
overview: Scripture exhorts believers to persevere in their spiritual journey with steadfastness and joy, relying on the strength of the everlasting God who never grows weary (Isaiah 40:28). The apostle Paul exemplifies this determination by valuing his life only insofar as it enables him to finish his course and fulfill the ministry entrusted to him by Christ (Acts 20:24). Christians are encouraged to avoid discouragement and obstacles that hinder obedience to the truth (Galatians 5:7) and to persist in doing good, trusting that in due time they will reap a harvest if they do not give up (Galatians 6:9). Like Paul, believers are called to press forward toward the goal of their high calling in Christ Jesus, continually striving to grow and fulfill God's purpose for their lives (Philippians 3:12, 14).
